summary.text: Del Taylor is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 84, an office he has held since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer by profession, he holds degrees from Washington University in St. Louis and the Kellogg School of Management.

paragraphs.text: Del Taylor earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis in 1988 and a graduate degree from the Kellogg School of Management in 1994.

Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working as an engineer and as a supply chain and computer systems expert, and that he has been affiliated with the National Society of Black Engineers, the National Black MBA Association and Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity Inc.
Taylor assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Wiley Price, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Budget Committee and the House Ways and Means Committee, on which he is the ranking minority member.
